toegepas.voor: Wilde diere in dieselfde veld as die pad.
toegepas.na: Wilde diere in die veld waardeur die pad geloop het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'in dieselfde veld as die pad' is an awkward comparison construction; the rewrite keeps the meaning and reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'in dieselfde veld as die pad' is a stiff comparison construction
toegepas.rede_keurder: The rewrite says the same thing naturally, matches the past tense of the other list items, and adds only one word.

toegepas.voor: Water wat in die droë maande ver uitmekaar was
toegepas.na: Waterplekke wat in die droë maande ver uitmekaar was
toegepas.rede_vinder: Water itself is not 'far apart'; the places where water could be found were.
toegepas.fout: water itself cannot be 'far apart'; the places where it was found were
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Waterplekke' fixes the logical slip without changing what the item says.

toegepas.blok: Hoe hulle die pad gevind het
toegepas.voor: Die land self het vir die reisigers gewys
toegepas.na: Die land self het vir hulle gewys
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids repeating 'reisigers' from the sentence directly before; 'hulle' refers back to it unambiguously.
toegepas.fout: 'reisigers' is repeated woodenly from the sentence directly before
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hulle' can only refer to the travellers in the previous sentence, and the protected wording is untouched.

laat_vaar.na: Op die roetes daarheen was daar
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'hierdie roetes' points back to routes the lesson has not yet named; 'die roetes daarheen' ties them to the journey just described, and the protected phrase is untouched.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hierdie roetes' points clearly enough to the inland-to-coast journey just described; 'daarheen' is a lateral move that also narrows the routes to one direction.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n Lang pad te voet vra elke dag water en kos.
laat_vaar.na: Wie lank te voet reis, het elke dag water en kos nodig.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A road that 'asks for' water and food is wooden personification; the rewrite says the same thing naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'vra' in the sense of 'demands' is idiomatic Afrikaans, so the original reads well and the rewrite is only different.

laat_vaar.voor: Siekte, ver van hulp by die huis.
laat_vaar.na: Siekte, ver van die huis en van hulp.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'ver van hulp by die huis' can be misread as being far from help while at home; the rewrite makes clear the traveller is far from home and its help.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original reads naturally as far from the help at home, while the proposal widens it to far from any help, which moves the meaning.

na_skrywer.voor: Die pad wat mense volg van een plek na 'n ander.
na_skrywer.na: Die pad wat mense van een plek na 'n ander volg.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: In an Afrikaans relative clause the verb goes last; 'volg' after the prepositional phrase is the natural order.
na_skrywer.fout: the prepositional phrase after 'volg' is a slightly less natural order in the relative clause
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a word-order improvement to a glossary definition rather than a plain grammar error, so the writer has to make it for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
